beats.say: If you watched the BBC's Amy Winehouse tribute, you saw Jorja Smith.
The Guardian says she performed in a BBC TV show tribute to Amy Winehouse's Back to Black.
Jorja Smith is from Walsall, and that is where her story starts.
But her newest chapter is the one to hear.
NME reviewed her album What Are The Odds, released on 21 August 2026, calling it embracing catharsis on the dancefloor.
After Amy's night, will What Are The Odds be your next listen?
